summary: The registrant Itaú Unibanco Holding S.A. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC for the month of April 2026, furnishing its updated bylaws as an exhibit. The filing is a routine report of a foreign private issuer providing its governing corporate document. It discloses authorized and subscribed capital figures, but does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, or other special-situation event. The bylaws amendment is an ordinary corporate governance matter with no deal terms, premium, board recommendation, or advisor. This is a standard current report, not a special situation.
